# has myth telling

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasMythTelling`](gmeow-hasMythTelling.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasMythTelling>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

Relates a myth to its concrete tellings or expressions — a [`BookRelease`](../classes/gmeow-BookRelease.md), [`Article`](../classes/gmeow-Article.md), [`MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md), social post, or other [`CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md). Non-functional: co-equal tellings coexist; superseded tellings are set [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).
